text:
Julie - Support: Hey team, incoming case: customer @emma reports signup bonus not applied after signup. She verified email, completed 3DS, but balance still 0. region=FR, acct=acct_7f9b, pm=GPay (virtual card). ticket#4567. Can someone pick this up?
Ravi (Payments): tagging in. do we have the payment_method verification webhook for acct_7f9b? sometimes virtual cards set a fraud hold.
Julie - Support: Logs show 3DS status=success, payment_method.created -> pm_ghX. But we see a later payment_hold=true in payments-service. snippet from payments logs: 
```
2024-11-08T14:02:11Z INFO acct=acct_7f9b pm=pm_ghX 3ds=success
2024-11-08T14:02:13Z WARN acct=acct_7f9b pm=pm_ghX hold_reason=BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH
```
Ravi (Payments): BIN_COUNTRY_MISMATCH -> our risk pipeline flagged the card because BIN country=US but IP region=FR. That triggers manual review and blocks autogrant. looks like webhook to support-grants didn't fire.
Matt (Billing): If the autogrant was blocked we can do a manual_credits_grant. Julie, can you confirm customer email and whether they requested immediate grant? need consent note for manual override.
Julie - Support: Customer confirmed they want the trial credits now. Email: emma+redwood@example.fr. Consent logged in ticket 4567.
Nadia (ENG-oncall): I'll check our grant-worker and webhook retries. Early suspicion: grant-worker crashed on null ref when processing risk metadata. pulling worker logs...
Nadia (ENG-oncall): grant-worker logs show an exception at 14:02:14 processing pm_ghX. stack: NullPointer at GrantProcessor.handleRiskMeta. looks like missing "country" field from risk-service response.
Ravi (Payments): Risk service should always include country but virtual-card tokenization sometimes returns empty. I'll patch but for now we should manual grant and add a safe fallback.
Matt (Billing): Manual grant steps (do this once):
```
# grant 1000 trial units
POST /internal/admin/accounts/acct_7f9b/credits
{ "amount": 1000, "reason": "manual signup grant - ticket 4567", "issued_by": "Matt (Billing)" }
```
Julie - Support: Can you run that and confirm? I'll message the customer.
Matt (Billing): Done. billing-bot confirmed: grant_id=grant_20241108_99, amount=1000, new_balance=1000. Response: 200 OK.
billing-bot: Grant processed: grant_20241108_99 acct=acct_7f9b amt=1000 by=Matt (Billing)
Julie - Support: Notified customer. They replied :thumbsup: and see credits in UI.
Nadia (ENG-oncall): I'll deploy a small fix to grant-worker to fallback when risk.country missing and add an alert if webhook to support-grants fails. creating PR now.
Ravi (Payments): Also going to add a rule to not block autogrants for virtual cards that pass 3DS but have BIN/IP mismatch until manual review completes. Will coordinate with risk ops.
Matt (Billing): Logging manual override per compliance. ticket updated. closing after confirmation.
Julie - Support: Closing ticket after customer confirmed. root cause: risk-service missing country on virtual-card responses -> grant-worker crashed -> autogrant not executed -> manual hold. Remediation: fix grant-worker null handling + risk rule change + note to ops.
Nadia (ENG-oncall): PR merged and deployed to staging. I'll monitor for 2h, then prod rollout.
Ravi (Payments): Filed follow-up with risk-ops: RISK-342.
Julie - Support: Thanks everyone. Ticket 4567 resolved. :white_check_mark:
